name: progress
description: How far an entity has got in a direction: the score of a climbing game (up), of a runner (right), of a diver (down). The distance is measured from where the entity started, only counts the best it reached (going back loses nothing) and is turned into a whole score.

components.name: Progress
components.description: Measures the furthest the entity has been since its first tick, in the direction (toward_x, toward_y): (0, -1) is up, as the climber of an endless climb (y grows downwards), (1, 0) is right, (0, 1) down and (-1, 0) left; the axis with the bigger number counts. distance is how far it got from where it began, in world units, and score is distance times scale as a whole number, rounded down. started and origin hold where it began (its coordinate along the direction).

systems.name: measure
systems.description: Updates the distance and the score of every Progress entity from its Position.
